title: Glowing skateboard
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='deck' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff6b35'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c92222'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='glow' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe066' stop-opacity='0.2'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#ffe066' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffe066' stop-opacity='0.2'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- glow aura under deck -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='44' ry='12' fill='#ffe066' opacity='0.25'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='38' ry='8' fill='#fff89a' opacity='0.35'/>

  <!-- deck -->
  <path d='M8,50 Q10,42 20,42 L80,42 Q90,42 92,50 Q90,58 80,58 L20,58 Q10,58 8,50 Z'
        fill='url(#deck)'/>
  <!-- deck lighter top lip -->
  <path d='M8,50 Q10,42 20,42 L80,42 Q90,42 92,50 Q90,46 80,46 L20,46 Q10,46 8,50 Z'
        fill='#ff9a6b'/>

  <!-- grip tape strip -->
  <rect x='12' y='47' width='76' height='4' rx='2' fill='#5a2a8c'/>

  <!-- trucks -->
  <rect x='22' y='58' width='10' height='5' rx='2' fill='#c9d4e0'/>
  <rect x='68' y='58' width='10' height='5' rx='2' fill='#c9d4e0'/>
  <rect x='21' y='62' width='12' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#8fa0b5'/>
  <rect x='67' y='62' width='12' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#8fa0b5'/>

  <!-- glowing wheels -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='68' r='8' fill='#2bd9a0'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='68' r='5' fill='#9ffce0'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='68' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <circle cx='74' cy='68' r='8' fill='#2bd9a0'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='68' r='5' fill='#9ffce0'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='68' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- wheel glow halos -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='68' r='11' fill='#2bd9a0' opacity='0.25'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='68' r='11' fill='#2bd9a0' opacity='0.25'/>

  <!-- glowing stripe on deck edge -->
  <path d='M8,50 Q10,58 20,58 L80,58 Q90,58 92,50' fill='none' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='2' opacity='0.9'/>

  <!-- sparkle above -->
  <path d='M50,20 L52,28 L60,30 L52,32 L50,40 L48,32 L40,30 L48,28 Z' fill='#fff89a' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='26' r='2' fill='#ffe066' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='24' r='2.5' fill='#ffe066' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
